mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A reconditioned Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 (306DT/306PS) engine typically costs between £6,500 and £9,500 for supply only, with fully rebuilt options ranging from £7,500 to £11,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of crankshaft failure in a Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warning sign is a distinct knocking or rumbling noise from the bottom end of the engine, particularly under load or during cold starts.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the body, chassis, and transmission are in sound condition. A £6,500-£9,500 reconditioned engine with upgraded components adds significant reliability and delivers 80,000-120,000 more miles.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 engine replacement take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service typically takes 3 to 7 days total. A pre-built reconditioned engine takes 1-2 days to fit (15-20 hours of labour).

mainEntity.name: Can the crankshaft failure in the Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 be prevented?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no guaranteed preventative fix for the factory crankshaft design flaw. The best mitigation is strict adherence to 5,000-mile oil change intervals using the correct OEM-spec oil.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the TDV6 and SDV6 variants launched in the Range Rover Sport, they introduced a highly capable V6 diesel architecture that dominated UK sales, offering a compelling blend of low-end torque, towing capability, and motorway refinement.

milestones.description: 276DT (2.7L TDV6), 190hp, introduced with the L320 launch, establishing the Ford/PSA Lion V6 diesel foundation.
306DT (3.0L TDV6, 258hp) and 306PS (3.0L SDV6, 292-306hp) introduced, offering increased power and torque but inheriting a critical crankshaft bearing design vulnerability.
Carried over to the all-new L494 generation with revised engine mounts, updated ECU mapping, and improved thermal management, though the core bottom-end architecture remained.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 delivers formidable capability, but its 3.0L V6 diesel architecture has a well-documented, catastrophic weakness. The 306DT and 306PS engines dominate replacement demand due to crankshaft bearing failure, while the earlier 276DT suffers from oil pump housing fractures. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded internal components designed to address the original failure point, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Crankshaft Bearing Failure - The Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 Silent Killer
problems.rootCause: A narrow bearing design with tin-aluminium coating fatigue, combined with extended service intervals or minor oil starvation, leads to bearing spin followed by instantaneous crankshaft fracture. Once snapped, the engine seizes and no rebuild is viable.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: There is no preventative fix once bearing wear begins; oil analysis is the only early detection method.
Supply of hot-tested reconditioned long engine with upgraded crankshaft and heavy-duty bearings, plus 15-20 hours labour.
repairOptions.longevity: The only viable option. Upgraded components address the original design flaw.

problems.recommendation: There is no preventative fix for a snapped crankshaft - when it fails, replacement is the only option. We strongly recommend a reconditioned engine with an upgraded crankshaft and heavy-duty bearings over a used unit. The additional investment buys a 12-month unlimited warranty and assurance that the known design flaw has been permanently addressed.

problems.h4: Oil Pump & Turbo Contamination - Why the Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6 Seizes
problems.rootCause: The 276DT oil pump housing is a known weak point at the tensioner mount. On 3.0L units, turbocharger seal failures can allow oil to drain away or contaminate the intercooler, starving the bottom end of lubrication and causing rapid bearing destruction.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replacement of the oil pump assembly or turbocharger, plus full system flush.
repairOptions.longevity: Effective only if caught before bottom-end damage occurs.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if oil starvation has already caused bearing spin or crankshaft damage.

items.question: What are the signs of crankshaft failure in a Range Rover Sport TDV6 SDV6?

In severe cases, the crankshaft snaps without warning, causing the engine to seize instantly.
